newsitem.title: USA: Sherwin-Williams sees record sales in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Sherwin-Williams sees record sales in 1997.

text.p: Sherwin-Williams Co said on Thursday that it expected to report a record year of sales and earnings improvement in 1997.

"We are confident that the management teams we have in place will continue to improve sales and operating results during the integration and rationalization process," said chief executive John Breen, referring to the company's Coating Segment, now in the process of integrating the majority of the acquired businesses.
The company reported that second quarter net sales increased 19.9 percent in 1997, while net income improved 13.8 percent compared to the year-ago period.
